title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.31412v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. translated_title: SQuAT：球面格向量量化感知训练
translated_abstract: 向量量化（VQ），特别是基于格的方法，为低比特大语言模型（LLM）提供了强大的率失真权衡，但其在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）下的行为仍未被充分理解。我们将格VQ-QAT扩展至十亿参数规模的LLM和数十亿token的训练场景，并提出SQuAT——一种形状-增益式VQ-QAT方法，采用针对形状和增益的分离直通估计器（STE）进行训练。SQuAT将权重分解为方向和幅度两个部分：归一化方向使用由$E_8$推导的球面码本进行量化，而增益则使用低比特标量量化器独立量化。我们证明，与应用于完整量化器、忽略形状-增益结构的标准STE不同，这些分离的STE会在切空间中为方向引入更新，从而形成一种隐式的球面（黎曼）优化形式。为实现可扩展性，我们开发了一种分布式……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SQuAT方法，通过分离的直通估计器将权重分解为方向（用E_8球面码本量化）和增益（用低比特标量量化器量化），将基于格的向量量化感知训练成功扩展到十亿参数级大语言模型，并实现了隐式的球面（黎曼）优化。
en_tdlr: SQuAT scales lattice-based vector quantization-aware training to billion-parameter LLMs by decomposing weights into directions quantized via an E8-derived spherical codebook and gains quantized with low-bit scalar quantizers, where separate straight-through estimators induce tangent-space updates that enable implicit spherical (Riemannian) optimization.
